column1: # Curated worklist: cache-declared options with no binding.
# docs/WORLD_INTERACTIONS.md S4 (the false-positive classes).  Status is NOT
# stored here -- `--worklist` re-resolves every row against the script tree,
# so a row cannot claim done while the binding is absent.
# REMOVED 2026-08-19, wiki says the interaction does not exist as the cache implies:
#     lists options as "None"; a container is USED on a fountain, and no
#     "Drink-from" is documented for The Feud. Implementing one would invent
#   altar       mm_gorillastatue1 "Gorilla Statue" -- a Monkey Madness prop
#     whose Pray-at carries quest semantics that could not be verified; a
#     generic prayer recharge there would be a guess, not a port.
# BLOCKED: ropeswing (7 rows) -- needs per-obstacle map geometry.
#   Every Swing-on obstacle moves the player a specific distance in a specific
#   direction to a specific landing tile (cf. barbarian_course.rs2's
#   the cache's binary map squares; nothing in configs/, pack/ or tools/ indexes
#   loc PLACEMENTS, only loc definitions. `loc_coord` gives the anchor at
#   runtime but not the direction or span of the gap.
#   Guessing a landing tile is worse than a dead click: it teleports the player
#   into a wall or across an unintended gap. The Barbarian Outpost swing is
#   already implemented under a different symbol (obstical_ropeswing1), so the
#   human_ropeswing_long -- is all present and only the coordinates are missing.
#   Unblock by measuring each of the 7 placements in-world or by adding a loc
#   placement dumper. Numbers that ARE known: Brimhaven swing Agility 10 / 3 xp,
